annotations.title: Get Boost plans and checkout links

description: Lists Boost, Foundplay's paid promotion: each plan's price, guaranteed plays, days and placements, how refunds work, and the free boost line. Given a game, also says whether it can be boosted and gives a checkout link for each plan. A person must open the link, sign in and pay on Stripe themselves. Read-only: nothing is bought by calling this.

game.description: The game's play link (where people play it), its Foundplay page link, or its Foundplay slug.
